title: Rescaling a vanishing n-density quotient: (ofReal r)⁻ⁿ · g(r·R) → 0
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, g : ℝ → [0, ∞] and R > 0. If g(ρ)/ENNReal.ofReal(ρ)^n → 0 in [0, ∞] as ρ → 0⁺ (filter 𝓝[>]0), then (ENNReal.ofReal r)⁻¹^n · g(r·R) → 0 in [0, ∞] as r → 0⁺.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => g ρ / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (ENNReal.ofReal r)⁻¹ ^ n * g (r * R)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
